The Internet Archive's optical character recognition of a public-domain printing is a mechanical transcription that adds no original authorship and is served without a copyright claim asserted over it, so nothing in the rights forbids retention. The bytes are not retained on the demonstrated-size ground guidance/sources.md allows: 8.50 MB, against 5.88 MB, which is the largest payload this library retains today across 10,461 files. THE COST OF THAT IS REAL AND IS STATED HERE RATHER THAN GLOSSED. What a reader with no network loses is the ability to replay this run's whole-volume searches of this volume, including its bounded negatives; what that reader keeps is the page images of the quoted columns, which are retained beside this record and carry the words themselves. The optical layer is in any case unusable as a text of record here, because its recognition of the polytonic Greek column is corrupt and the retrieving lane forbade quotation from it.

work.description: Basil's homilies on the Psalms. The homily on Psalm 33 expounds both halves of the Offertory of the Roman Fourteenth Sunday after Pentecost consecutively: at verse 8 the single angel of the Lord is worth a whole encamped army and 'in circuitu' is a city wall fortifying in front, guarding the rear and leaving neither flank unwatched; at verse 9 'taste and see' rests on the soul's senses being named homonymously with the body's.
work.title: Homiliae in Psalmos
